crossRefs.note: Look at this. We have searched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
“However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
“Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
“Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

translations.web: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
translations.bsb: Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
translations.kjv: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
translations.asv: I will show thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare:
